content.content:
Tilts-The-Jug: "There is, if the hands are careful enough. The Chapter takes from those who can bear the loss. It takes no more than that. A hand that breaks what it touches is no use to us, so I must see how yours work. Keeps-What-Floats stands on the dock just west of this door. He took a necklace of polished blue jaspers from a Lookout of ours, one of the Chapter, while that Lookout slept. He keeps it in a locked strongbox under the eaves north-west of the house. Bring the necklace back, so that the Lookout has it again. Do Keeps-What-Floats no harm. If he is hurt, there is no pay and no place with us. Here are three lockpicks. There are three ways open. You can open his strongbox with the picks, or you can take his key, which he may give for good talk or sell for coin. Sits-By-The-Water drinks with him on the dock. Ask her about his habits, because I will not tell them."
Objective completed: Speak to Tilts-The-Jug inside the house on Soulrest's dock, behind the door beside S'Tabi.
Journal entry (A Dry Hand in a Wet City): Tilts-The-Jug, who keeps the Night-Reed Chapter's desk, wants to see how I work, and she gave me three lockpicks. A dock thief, Keeps-What-Floats, took a necklace of blue jaspers from a sleeping Chapter Lookout and keeps it in a locked strongbox under the eaves north-west of the house. I'm to take it back without harming him, by opening the strongbox or by getting his key; Sits-By-The-Water, who drinks with him, can tell me his habits. Keeps-What-Floats stands on the dock just west of the door beside S'Tabi.
New objective: Take the Blue Jasper Necklace from Keeps-What-Floats's strongbox, or get his key from him (Speech 35, or 60 gold).
Added: Lockpick x3
Tilts-The-Jug has nothing more to say to you.

content.content:
Bent-Spine: "A merchant drowned in the deep water just south of the trapdoor you came down. His lockbox of pledges lies locked on the floor, where he went down. A pledge is a thing a client left with him against a loan. Three of his clients wait on the south bank of the deep water for a diver, and each says one thing in the box is theirs. I want the box emptied before they find one. Dive down, open it and take what is inside. What becomes of what you take is yours to say. I will not tell you whom to give it to. The Chapter takes from those who can bear the loss, and these pledges are other people's. Whoever holds them can sell them back, or can sell silence about them. Blackmail is no trade of ours, and I will not have a Lookout of mine in it. The lock is a Novice lock. Here are three lockpicks. Go up through the trapdoor, and the deep water lies just south of it."
Objective completed: Ask Bent-Spine about the work he has.

- S'Tabi, the Khajiit trader on Soulrest's dock, told me that if I want quiet work I should ask for Tilts-The-Jug, who keeps the Night-Reed Chapter's desk in the house behind him. I'm to speak to her inside the house on Soulrest's dock, behind the door beside S'Tabi.
- Tilts-The-Jug, who keeps the Night-Reed Chapter's desk, wants to see how I work, and she gave me three lockpicks. A dock thief, Keeps-What-Floats, took a necklace of blue jaspers from a sleeping Chapter Lookout and keeps it in a locked strongbox under the eaves north-west of the house. I'm to take it back without harming him, by opening the strongbox or by getting his key; Sits-By-The-Water, who drinks with him, can tell me his habits. - I gave Tilts-The-Jug the Blue Jasper Necklace, and because Keeps-What-Floats came to no harm, she paid me a hundred gold. I'm to take the coast ship from Soulrest's dock, east of the house, to Lilmoth, then go down the trapdoor north of Pusbottom at the edge of the deep water to speak to Bent-Spine below. The ship lands at Lilmoth's dock, and Pusbottom lies west of that dock.
- I went down through the trapdoor north of Pusbottom to the Night-Reed Chapter under Lilmoth, and Bent-Spine, the Chapter's fence, took me in as a Lookout. input.command: /tmp/ptb-a1tk54rg/play end --take 'Short and easy to follow. Two quests: get a necklace back for the thieves'"'"' guild, then empty a drowned lockbox and decide who gets the contents. I also never found out who the other dock people were, such as Sits-By-The-Water, because I did not need them. I would like to know what the Chapter asks of me next, and whether Okan-Tei and Dar-Zeel come back angry.'

Both strongboxes and lockboxes were already unlocked, so the lockpicks were never used. The ship ride was instant. I never saw the dive or any water, which was a bit flat. I also never found out who the other dock people were, such as Sits-By-The-Water, because I did not need them. I would like to know what the Chapter asks of me next, and whether Okan-Tei and Dar-Zeel come back angry.'
